ru-RU.label: Casino Hold'em
ru-RU.description: Анте, флоп, решение колл или пас и вскрытие против квалифицирующегося дилера.

lobby.description: Ante, decide after the flop, then settle a dealer-qualified community-card showdown through the play-token ledger.

distinct_module_proof.primary_mechanic: House-banked community-card poker with ante, post-flop call/fold, dealer qualification, and deterministic seven-card showdown evaluation.
not_a_variant_of_existing_games: Not Three Card Poker: no three-card-only hand ranking, Pair Plus wager, or ante/play settlement without community cards.
Not Multi-Hand Video Poker: no draw-poker holds, no independent hand lanes, and no solitaire Jacks-or-Better paytable.
Not Hi-Lo: no one-card higher/lower prediction.
Not Casino War or Dragon Tiger: no single-card high-card comparison decides the result.
Not Red Dog: no spread between two exposed cards or spread odds.
Not Baccarat: no Punto Banco totals, natural rules, or third-card tableau.
